title: Warm Pillowy Uruguayan Vegetable Curry
description: This ovo-vegetarian friendly Uruguayan dish is a cultured and comforting weeknight meal featuring green curry paste and flambe techniques, with a pillowy texture from the addition of eggs and coconut milk.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the green curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the sliced red bell pepper and zucchini, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt, then pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in the skillet.
Use a spatula to gently scramble the eggs with the vegetables, then push the mixture to one side of the skillet.
Add a small amount of coconut oil to the empty side of the skillet, then add a small amount of green curry paste and ignite the mixture to flambe the curry paste, cooking for 30 seconds.
Stir the flambeed curry paste into the egg and vegetable mixture, then pour in the coconut milk and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the curry for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and the eggs are cooked through.
